purpose: splat-room frame bundle: the fixed camera gets no parallax except HIS MOTION -- pose variety across these sessions is the only baseline change the reconstruction gets
selection_rule: measured motion richness = mean |dluma| between sampled luma frames, ranked; sessions >= 30 s for pose variety, plus the short top-motion session and the manual take. The brief's 'T-pose session' carries no marker in any metadata -- stated here rather than guessed
frame_rule: every 50th frame of the native-res color webm (640x480 vp9, ~19.8 fps -> ~1 frame / 2.5 s), re-encoded jpeg q92; luma.raw was NOT used (160x96 grayscale -- the webm is the fidelity source)
